3.t: And the Even and the Odd,

4.t: And the night when it departeth,

5.t: There surely is an oath for thinking man.

6.t: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,

8.t: The like of which was not created in the lands;

9.t: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;

10.t: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,

11.t: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,

13.t: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.

14.t: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.

15.t: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.

16.t: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.

17.t: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan

18.t: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.

19.t: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.

20.t: And love wealth with abounding love.

21.t: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,

22.t: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,

23.t: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?

24.t: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!

25.t: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!

26.t: None bindeth as He then will bind.

27.t: But ah! thou soul at peace!

28.t: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
